description: This file defines a set of custom assertions for the DittoHeaders class, used for testing and validation purposes within the project. It leverages AssertJ for assertions and provides methods to verify the presence and values of various headers like correlation ID, schema version, authorization context, and response requirements.

classes.name: DittoHeadersAssert
classes.description: Custom assertion class for DittoHeaders objects, providing fluent assertion methods for testing headers properties.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Asserts that the DittoHeaders contains the specified correlation ID.

methods.name: assertContains
methods.description: Helper method to assert that an Optional contains an expected value, with custom error message.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Asserts that the DittoHeaders has a correlation ID present.

methods.name: assertIsEmpty
methods.description: Helper method to assert that an Optional is empty, with custom error message.

methods.name: hasSchemaVersion
methods.description: Asserts that the DittoHeaders has the specified JSON schema version.

methods.name: hasNoSchemaVersion
methods.description: Asserts that the DittoHeaders does not have a schema version.

methods.name: hasNoAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Asserts that the DittoHeaders does not contain any authorization subjects.

methods.name: hasAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Asserts that the DittoHeaders has the specified AuthorizationContext.

methods.name: hasReadSubject
methods.description: Deprecated. Asserts that the DittoHeaders includes specific read subjects.

methods.name: hasNoReadSubjects
methods.description: Deprecated. Asserts that the DittoHeaders has no read subjects.

methods.name: hasIsResponseRequired
methods.description: Asserts that the 'response required' flag matches the expected value.

methods.name: hasAllowPolicyLockout
methods.description: Asserts that the 'policy lockout' flag matches the expected value.
